d:
The arrest of former Tamil Nadu School Education Minister Anbil Mahesh Poyyamozhi in an alleged multi-crore corruption case has triggered political reactions across the State. Poyyamozhi was arrested by Chennai Police on October 26 and remanded to judicial custody till November 6.
The case involves allegations of collecting money from private school managements in exchange for government recognition and statutory approvals. As the Central Crime Branch continues its investigation, political leaders have weighed in on the arrest and the allegations surrounding the case.
